rawText: During the post-war years, our parents continued to prosper. The farming business of approximately 200 acres had become completely mechanized with the latest technology, equipment, and farming methods, But, by the time Mother and Dad had begun to feel the wear and tear of the years, and the children began to appreciate the wisdom of their counsel and cherished value of their presence, Dad found it necessary to retire from his role as manager. He finally turned the farming operation over to the youngest son, Claude, who had been the assistant operator since his return form the service in 1946. Mother and Dad continued to serve their church and community well. Dad continued to serve as trustee chairman, and Mother as the "Mother of the church”. After 87 years of faithful service to his family, community, church and country, Dad passed away on April 16, 1973. Five years later, at the age of 88 years, our dear Mother passed on Christmas Day, December, 1978.
